regime_context: This is a one-narrative regime: Banks (512800.SS) hold nearly all thematic leadership with high durability, high breadth (0.833), and elevated crowding, while only 2 of 22 themes are eligible and the absolute-trend gate historically did NOT hold on China A-shares (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape). The detector is display/attention only here — a focus lens, not an alpha source — so any directional lean must be low-conviction and falsifiable.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks' one-narrative dominance (crowding z=1.82, breadth 0.833) starts to decay: I would retire this watch if Banks' breadth drops below 0.6 OR its rank score falls below 0.7 while another theme (e.g. SOE Blue Chips, durability 0.85) becomes eligible — a confirmed handoff, not a prediction.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with trend-state Hurst, high durability (0.75), and the strongest breadth (0.833), suggesting cohesive participation rather than a single-name story. However, crowding is flagged (z=1.82, crowded=true) and the trend gate has no drawdown edge on this market, so this is a size-down-favored continuation read, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.82 near a one-narrative top means reflexive flush risk is elevated, and the backtest shows the absolute-trend gate does not cut drawdown here, so trend-following continuation may whipsaw.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Baijiu / Liquor
theses.thesis: Baijiu shows decent durability (0.60) and breadth (0.857), but crowding is elevated (z=1.32) and it is not eligible (score 0.235). The detector gives no edge here, and crowding is only a size-down caution — not a reason to expect negative returns — so the honest lean is to avoid initiating an overweight on a crowded, ineligible lagging theme.
evidence: breadth=0.857 (high, but trend-health is not enough alone)
theses.dissent: High breadth and durable trend could still produce positive carry even without the gate, and avoiding it forfeits participation if the consumer narrative re-emerges.

falsifier.text: 512690.SS beats CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is technically eligible (score 0.16) but crowded (z=1.35), has mixed Hurst, and low breadth (0.429) — leadership without cohesion. With the trend gate having no drawdown edge on this market, eligibility alone is not a reason to lean in.
theses.dissent: An eligible mixed-state theme could mean-revert higher if the healthcare narrative consolidates, and low breadth does not preclude a re-acceleration.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ beats CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days.
